steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Fall back! Everyone, regroup!

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Let them go!

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: The enemy is going to cut off our squads at this rate!

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: We can't afford to let that happen, in case more reinforcements show up...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: These Reunion forces... are not targeting us!

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Our top priority is to keep our operators safe!

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Snipers, stop attacking the fleeing Reunion forces!

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Focus on helping Madam Hoshiguma first!

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: So annoying!

steps.name: W
steps.text: Not bad, not bad. You actually managed to soak up all my attacks~

steps.name: W
steps.text: But, how much more can you take?

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: That depends on how long you can survive!

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: ---Ch'en! Hurry up!

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Surround that woman!

steps.name: W
steps.text: Ohhh, did L.G.D. come to play?

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Lower your weapons!

steps.name: W
steps.text: We meet again, Madam~

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: You won't talk your way out of this.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: All that you've done to Lungmen... I'll do to you twice over.

steps.name: W
steps.text: Oh my, how scary~

steps.name: W
steps.text: But I'm not here to play with you today.

steps.name: W
steps.text: Amiya, catch~

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Me? This is... some kind of phone?

steps.name: W
steps.text: That's right. Someone wants to talk to you~

steps.name: W
steps.text: Anyway, that concludes my mission.

steps.name: W
steps.text: Before I forget, I have something for you as well, Madam.

steps.name: W
steps.text: See you later~

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Watch out!

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: ...A short-range bomb...?!

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: No, it's a flashbang!

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Don't let her trick you...

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: ...It's too late.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: She already got away.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: She sure got out of there fast. All she needed was a momentary distraction to slip through our defenses.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Also, you should be careful of that thing you're holding. If it's another bomb...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: This... seems like a regular cellphone...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Except... could it be...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Hello?

steps.name: Misha
steps.text: Is that...

steps.name: Misha
steps.text: Amiya...?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Misha! Tell me, where are you?! I'm...

steps.name: Misha
steps.text: Amiya...

steps.name: Girl's Voice
steps.text: ...Prioritize... treating the heavily injured!! We need a blood transfusion here!! Hurry!!

steps.name: Young Man's Voice
steps.text: ...Damn it... Why... Even though we're all Infected...

steps.name: Young Man's Voice
steps.text: Rhodes Island... why would they do this to us...?!

steps.name: Girl's Voice
steps.text: ...We were always abandoned from the very beginning!! We have no escape... nothing at all...!

steps.name: Boy's Voice
steps.text: Don't die! Don't leave me!! We promised... We promised to go home together...!

steps.name: Girl's Voice
steps.text: *sobbing*... Brother... please don't...

steps.name: Misha
steps.text: Do you hear their voices...?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Reunion's... Infected?

steps.name: Misha
steps.text: I remember now.

steps.name: Misha
steps.text: No, I never forgot. I just... didn't want to remember...

steps.name: Misha
steps.text: That's right. It was Reunion that destroyed my home. My father also...

steps.name: Misha
steps.text: But... we brought it upon ourselves.

steps.name: Misha
steps.text: That year, I watched my younger brother, dragged away before my own eyes... He called out for me, crying my name, but I turned away...

steps.name: Misha
steps.text: ...and hid inside my room.

steps.name: Misha
steps.text: When he found me again... He had sacrificed so many things.

steps.name: Misha
steps.text: Even though he still loved me, I was afraid, and I ran away...

steps.name: Misha
steps.text: But I now understand.

steps.name: Misha
steps.text: Everything that he has done... was just to give the oppressors a taste of the suffering that the Infected go through every day.

steps.name: Misha
steps.text: And now, I am one of them.

steps.name: Misha
steps.text: ...It is time for me to atone for my sins.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Misha, don't be rash!

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: No matter how you treated the Infected in the past, you can always change--

steps.name: Misha
steps.text: It's no use.

steps.name: Misha
steps.text: What can I change?

steps.name: Misha
steps.text: Because I... was one of those who turned a blind eye...

steps.name: Misha
steps.text: After becoming an Infected, I finally... can see it clearly.

steps.name: Misha
steps.text: The way normal people treated the Infected... is how the Infected would treat normal people.

steps.name: Misha
steps.text: Because they deserve it.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: No...

steps.name: Misha
steps.text: All of this... Is nothing more than the weeds of evil that have sprouted from the seeds of cruelty I planted...

steps.name: Misha
steps.text: This torment is my karmic justice.

steps.name: Misha
steps.text: But, why... Why?

steps.name: Misha
steps.text: Why did that happen to him, even though he had done nothing wrong?!

steps.name: Misha
steps.text: All he was guilty of was suddenly coming down with the infection...

steps.name: Misha
steps.text: He was so young... He had only started asking for me to help with his homework!

steps.name: Misha
steps.text: If only I... If only I had protected him back then...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Misha! Please calm down!

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: You didn't hurt any innocents! None of this was your fault!

steps.name: Misha
steps.text: From the very beginning, who's innocent?!

steps.name: Misha
steps.text: The only thing that's wrong... is this label that the Infected have been given...

steps.name: Misha
steps.text: If this is a cycle of revenge against each other... Then tell me, who was the one who set this tragedy in motion...?!

steps.name: Misha
steps.text: If Ursus had never treated the Infected like monsters...

steps.name: Misha
steps.text: ...then what reason would anyone have to hate Ursus so much?!

steps.name: Misha
steps.text: Who ordained that the Infected must suffer like this?!

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Misha...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Skullshatterer is dead. You can come back to us now. I promise, we'll...

steps.name: Misha
steps.text: Amiya... I've already found my answer...

steps.name: Misha
steps.text: I am an Infected.

steps.name: Misha
steps.text: I stand on the side of the Infected.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Don't...

steps.name: Misha
steps.text: That's right, Amiya. You're also an Infected...

steps.name: Misha
steps.text: So you should be able to understand.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: That's right. I'm just like you... just like everyone in Rhodes Island. We all understand how you feel...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: But, Misha, even if you accept your identity, that won't change who you are!

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Please wait for me! I'm coming to find you!

steps.name: Misha
steps.text: Don't come.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: ...Misha! Where are you--

steps.name: Misha
steps.text: You're right, Amiya. You're absolutely right... I was just feeling guilty. Guilty... because I was too weak.

steps.name: Misha
steps.text: But I've made up my mind.

steps.name: Misha
steps.text: Even if it's only a single step... it is a step that I must take.

steps.name: Misha
steps.text: I'm sorry, Amiya. I'm so sorry...

steps.name: Misha
steps.text: To be an Infected... is to be a part of Reunion.

steps.name: Misha
steps.text: That is all we are, after all...

steps.name: Misha
steps.text: Goodbye...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Misha? Misha?! Misha!!
